words.headline: Thursday Sign Language: Posted-Parking Violations Jump to 806
words.blurb: Parking wars led the city with 3,162 requests, as posted parking sign violations hit 806 against a typical 519. Even on a 66-degree afternoon, whole buildings with no heat and no hot water nearly doubled to 270.
words.card_line: Read the sign. No, really, read the sign.

boroughs.Bronx: Home repairs led with 607 requests, and 433 no-heat calls kept radiators in the spotlight.
boroughs.Brooklyn: Parking wars ruled big, with 1,459 requests, more than any other borough's top worry.
boroughs.Manhattan: A near tie: 513 home repairs edged out 511 noise complaints.
boroughs.Queens: Parking wars ran the show with 829 requests, well ahead of home repairs at 305.
boroughs.Staten Island: Street fixes topped the list with 82 requests, just ahead of 67 parking gripes.
